Hi Aisha,

Quick heads up — our billing team just tried to process invoice 5478 (May usage) and Stripe returned a hard decline (card issuer). We got a notice referencing 'card_declined' and the transaction was returned yesterday evening.

We want to avoid a chargeback; finance asked for:
- confirmation of the attempted charge and invoice PDF
- a short timeline for retry / card update communication
- any evidence we can send to our bank if they start a dispute (merchant descriptor, service dates, PO reference)

I've attached the invoice and a screenshot of the decline. Please advise what you need from us and whether Redwood can provide a retry window or temporary hold.

Thanks,

Hi Trevor — thanks for the quick note and for attaching the screenshots. Sorry for the hassle.

Proposed immediate plan to avoid a dispute:
1) We will send a secure card-update link to the billing contact and keep the invoice in pending status for 7 days. If a new card is added and the customer authorizes a retry within that window, we will attempt one automatic retry.
2) If Acme prefers, we can accept an offline payment (ACH/wire) and mark the invoice paid on receipt, but that may add a 2–3 business-day processing delay.
3) I'll assemble a short evidence pack (merchant descriptor, invoice PDF, service dates, support logs) that your team can share with your bank if they request it.

Action items for us:
- Marissa: ready to prepare the evidence package and send to Trevor once I confirm the final descriptor.
- Ben: can you run the dunning / retry workflow and trigger a single retry after Trevor updates the card?

Trevor — if you confirm you want the card-update link, I'll send it now and mark the invoice pending for the 7-day retry window. Otherwise confirm whether you'd like to pay by wire and we'll send instructions.

Best,
Aisha
